title: Schedules
name: Name
manualModelHint: Leave blank for the agent default, choose a discovered model, or enter its exact ID. A requested model must be applied before the task starts.
catalogUnsupported: This agent does not provide a model catalog. You can enter an exact model ID.
catalogEmpty: The agent returned no models. You can enter an exact model ID.
noShells: No installed shell is available, or shell tasks are disabled on this PC.
cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
pausedDefault: New schedules start paused. Run now also works while paused.
rightsWarning: Tasks run on this PC with the same rights as its signed-in user. The workspace is not a sandbox. Tasks may change files, use the network and incur costs. Cancelling cannot undo external effects.
agentWarning: Agent permissions still require your approval in Open execution; they are never automatically granted.
invalid: Check the required fields and deadline before saving.
confirmEnabled: This authorizes recurring execution on this PC without a new confirmation each time. Tasks run with the PC user’s rights, not in a sandbox. Existing agent permission prompts still require approval.
confirmPaused: The schedule will be saved paused. It will not run automatically until you enable it. You can preview its timing or explicitly run it now.
historyHint: Latest 100 runs. Active runs refresh while this screen is open.
emptyHistory: No runs yet. Use Run now or enable this schedule.
outputTruncated: Only the last 65,536 characters were retained.
approvalHint: This agent is waiting for permission. Open this execution to review it in the existing approval screen.
confirmCancel: Stop this execution? Any changes or external effects already made cannot be undone.
confirmDelete: Delete this schedule and its history? Any active execution will be cancelled. External effects cannot be undone.
confirmRun: Run this task once now, even if paused? It uses the PC user’s rights and may change files, use the network and incur costs. Another run of this schedule cannot start while one is in progress.
confirmPause: Pause future executions? An execution already running will continue; cancel it separately in history.
intro: Recurring tasks for this workspace, separate from conversations. Nanachi must be running on the PC. Missed slots are skipped. Each schedule runs at most once at a time.
empty: No schedules yet. Create an agent task or a direct command; it starts paused.
